abstract: An increased frequency of various genitourinary anomalies, infertility, and testicular cancer among males has been reported to follow intrauterine exposure to diethylstilbestrol, but not all studies have confirmed an association. This study was designed to determine whether a cohort of males exposed in utero to diethylstilbestrol had a higher frequency of urogenital abnormalities than an unexposed cohort. Biases in selection of exposed and control participants were minimized. Of 828 exposed and 676 control men studied by medical-record review, 265 exposed men and 274 controls also underwent a special clinical examination. Overall, the data suggest that diethylstilbestrol exposure of males in utero did not increase their risk of genitourinary abnormalities, infertility, or testicular cancer. Previously reported increased frequencies of these abnormalities in diethylstilbestrol-exposed men may have resulted from selection biases or differences in diethylstilbestrol use, or both.
abstract_ja: 本研究は、子宮内でジエチルスチルベストロール(DES)に曝露された男性が、尿路生殖器異常、不妊、精巣がんの頻度が高いかを検討するために計画された。バイアスを最小化するため、曝露群と対照群の選択を工夫した。診療記録の調査では、DES曝露男性828例と対照男性676例を調べた。このうち、曝露男性265例と対照男性274例は特別な臨床検査も受けた。全体として、このデータは、子宮内でのDES曝露が男性の尿路生殖器異常、不妊、精巣がんのリスクを高めなかったことを示唆している。DES曝露男性でこれらの異常の頻度が高いと以前報告されていたのは、選択バイアス、DES使用の違い、またはその両方によるものかもしれない。
